title: Needy
body: The app itself is good but it asks for a review every day which is needlessly annoying even if you‘ve rated the app.
author: Alohakrisi

title: Just Awesome!
body: I use the app since more than a year and I just love it. Simple, beautiful, reliable and always getting new Features that make sense!
author: dietikerluca

title: New feature pls
body:
I love the app, great job creating it! Would it be possible to add a feature where one can track how much he/she is saving up by not smoking for example? Lets say uf I don‘t smoke for a week I can also see how much money I didn‘t spend on cigarettes. Or if I reduce the amount I smoke the same thing.
The feature could ask you how much the user spends normally and how much he/she would save by decreasing the amount he/she smokes.
Thank you guys a lot!
author: BreLucca

title: Good
body: Very good app but I think that when we add a shortcut to the habit when we add a step of the habit should run immediatly with out clicking the Little icon
author: Pedro237353

title: All data lost when syncing
body:
I had the app back up on iCloud, so when I purchased a new iPhone I expected a transfer to the new device. Instead ALL DATA (months of history) were deleted from BOTH old and new device.
This app is a joke
author: Reviewer T22

title: Amazing!
body: Very intuitive and appealing user interface. 11/10
author: Dr_Dominic

title: Peak Fiction
body:
Its very lovely made with a lot animations and dopamine triggers.

If you want something to help building Habits, this is a great way for it. But in the end its your choice if you keep to it.
author: Flixnuss

title: Simply the best habit tracker out there!👌🏼✨
body:
Keep up the good work!👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼✨
I‘d love to see some added features like an AI coach or insights about correlations.
author: Donatius

title: The best
body: I tried many habits tracker and this one is the simplest yet the best habit tracker, it does it perfectly, with no distractions and with faire prices. Other apps are made for money and have useless features just to charge more money on subscriptions. This app does what it claims to do and does it perfectly. Thank you dev(s) 😁
author: clmmouf-0

title: Excellent
body:
I’ve tried several of them, but this is really what I hoped for!
Keep on!
author: cardisim

title: Amazing app but…
body:
I would like to use it more like a log. If my weekly goal is 2x gyms  I would like to see which days I went. The same thing for Bad habits - See which days I ate sweets.

Also beeing able to add comments to each habit and day. For example Monday I ate 100gr chocolate
author: Der bartige Bärtmeister

title: Great and Simple
body:
Best Habit tracker for me. Its very simple and there are no distractions or KI that wants to push me in a certain direction. 
Keep on the good work!
author: anwawa

title: Leonard
body: An awesome way to simply track your habits. No distractions, just a great app.
author: Leocser

title: Simply Amazing!
body: Got exactly everything what I want 🤩
author: houen

title: Sehr guter...
body:
... Art "Timer" der aber mitzählt ob man seine neuen Gewohnheiten auch macht (oder man kann auch negative Angewohnheiten zeitlich runterzählen lassen. z.B. bestimmte Zeit nicht zu einer negativen Angewohnheiten zu greifen)

Sehr, sehr gut
author: Beat68*

title: Lovely on all my devices
body: I'm really happy that I can use the app on all my devices and the design looks great on mac, iphone and apple watch. Great job!
author: Daniele Catalanotto

title: Great design! Lovely support!
body: Love the app design and how it works on all my design. I had a question and the creator of the app answered in a very lovely way.
author: Daniele Catalanotto
